headline: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited: Scheme of Arrangement filed with NCLT
sum: Apollo Hospitals filed a Scheme of Arrangement with NCLT, notifying stock exchanges of corporate restructuring proceedings under the Companies Act, 2013.
implication: A Scheme of Arrangement signals potential intra-group restructuring, subsidiary merger, or debt/equity reorganisation - triggering NCLT approval as a gating item and requiring careful review of minority shareholder protections and creditor dissent thresholds under ss. 230–232 CA.
detail: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited filed a Scheme of Arrangement and formally notified the National Stock Exchange (NSE) via the corporate disclosure mechanism on 24 June 2026. The document was filed as an NCLT proceeding notification, indicating that the company has initiated or is proceeding with a corporate restructuring or amalgamation under Part VIII of the Companies Act, 2013. The specific structure, parties, consideration, and regulatory milestones remain to be disclosed in full scheme documents and NCLT petitions.
